title: Fremont Library Robot Demo
description1: Variable Velocity visited the Fremont Library to share robotics with some of our youngest audiences yet. Kids and parents gathered in the community room to watch our competition robot in action.
description2: Team members drove the robot, answered questions and explained how it works in simple, hands-on terms, sparking curiosity about engineering and coding in elementary-age kids.
bullets: Brought our competition robot to the Fremont Library
Ran live driving demos for young kids and families
Answered questions about how robots are built and coded
Sparked early interest in STEM and FIRST programs
